name: Paid Ads Auditor
cadence: Checks Google Ads daily at 6:15 AM, quick health check at 1:15 PM.

sources.label: Google Ads API read
sources.why: the Google Ads API read is not on yet (#3794): Mimi turns on Google Ads API access for GCP project ihg-sales-brain and adds the Brain's service account to each Google Ads account as Standard (access: Standard (writes disabled in code), #3819); then ADS_API_LIVE is switched on

does: Weekly audit of Google ads: wasted search terms, wrong landing pages, our venues bidding against each other
Checks Google Ads daily at 6:15 AM: spend with no conversions, impressions dropping to zero, disapproved ads, limited or paused campaigns, landing pages that 404, two venues on one search term
Quick health check at 1:15 PM, a card only if something is wrong: a disapproved ad, a campaign that stopped serving, a landing page that 404s, spend running well ahead of normal with no conversions
Every Monday, per venue: the Google keywords and search terms and the Meta ads that led to conversions that week, the ones that spent with none, and drafted changes for K&M

traits.cant: Change a campaign, budget, bid or ad
traits.instead: Writes the change for the agency (K&M) to make

traits.cant: Write to Google Ads, even though its Google Ads access is Standard
traits.instead: access: Standard (writes disabled in code). It only reads; a write is refused before it is sent, and a reported one stops the monitor with an alarm (#3819)

needs: Mimi: turn on Google Ads API access for GCP project ihg-sales-brain and add the Brain's service account to each of the 6 active Google Ads accounts as Standard (#3794, #3819; access: Standard (writes disabled in code))

Katherine: the IHG Brain system user in Meta Business Settings, assigned to each IHG Meta ad account with view-performance access (ads_read); its token goes to the Box Keychain as meta-ads-read-token and the account ids into META_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS. The Engagement Sleuth rides on the same token (#3804)
